legal_name: Tamga Network — Identity Service, App Store Review (DEMO)
assurance_basis: ADR-0033: DEMO signer for app-store review only. Credentials are issued after a single-use review code with simulated identity proofing (no real person, no real document). Registered at I1 so that every production policy (I2+) rejects them; only the review policies of Tamga Verify accept them. Never valid for real use.

authentic_source.name: Simulated identity proofing for app-store review (no real person) — ADR-0033
